stemMd: Some members of the orchestra also teach. Every teacher in the orchestra reads music fluently. No fluent music reader is in the beginner class. Which must be true?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Every beginner belongs to the orchestra.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Some orchestra members are not in the beginner class.

options.label: C
options.textMd: No orchestra member is in the beginner class.

options.label: E
options.textMd: No teacher outside the orchestra reads fluently.

explanationMd: Start with the existing orchestra members who teach. They are fluent readers and therefore excluded from the beginner class. This establishes a particular conclusion, not a claim about every orchestra member.

distractorRationale.c: Only the teaching subset is covered by the chain.
distractorRationale.d: The teacher-to-fluent relation cannot be reversed.
distractorRationale.a: The premises establish no such membership.
distractorRationale.e: The premises say nothing about outside teachers.
